auth_notes: Personal access token (recommended) or OAuth access token. Header: Authorization: Bearer {token}. API keys deprecated since 2024-02-01. Token must be granted the specific base as a resource plus the scopes below.

rate_limits.per_token: 50 requests/sec across all traffic for a given user/service account

resources.name: Base
resources.notes: whoami is the lightweight token-validation call (no base required) — used for the Auth component.

resources.name: Table
resources.notes: Body: { name, description?, fields: [{ name, type, description?, options? }] } — first field becomes the primary field. Airtable has no public endpoint to create views (grid/gallery/kanban); 'layout' scope for v1 means table/column structure only.

resources.name: Field
resources.notes: Single/multi-select field options carry a fixed set of 40 color names per choice (see select_colors below) — this is the only per-item 'color' surface Airtable's API exposes; there is no per-record cell-color write.

resources.name: Record
resources.notes: Batch write endpoints (create/update/replace/delete) accept up to 10 records per call. update_records supports upsert via performUpsert.fieldsToMergeOn when id is omitted. list_records paginates via offset, pageSize max 100. Attachment field values can be set directly here as [{"url": "..."}] and Airtable fetches + hosts the file — this covers the URL-based picture input without needing the Attachment resource below.

resources.name: Attachment
resources.notes: IMPORTANT: this endpoint lives on a different host — https://content.airtable.com — not https://api.airtable.com. Body: { contentType, file (base64), filename }. Max 5MB. Covers picture-from-file-path and picture-from-bitmap (encode local bytes/in-memory bitmap to base64 client-side); picture-from-URL instead goes through create_records/update_records on the Record resource above.

resources.name: RecordComment
resources.notes: Secondary resource — include only if a stated workflow needs record comments.

resources.name: Webhook
resources.notes: Requires an externally reachable notification URL and payload polling — likely out of scope for v1 given Grasshopper has no persistent server; propose skip unless a workflow specifically needs it.

api_hierarchy: Base -> Table (incl. create_table layout) -> Field (incl. select colors) / Record -> Attachment / RecordComment; Webhook attaches to Base
openapi_spec_notes: Airtable does not publish a static, download-once OpenAPI/Swagger spec covering all bases generically; its API reference is generated per-base. Use extract_from_docs per endpoint in Phase 6.
